title: Implicit-explicit all-speed schemes for compressible Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations
summary: We propose a second-order implicit-explicit (IMEX) time-stepping scheme for the isentropic, compressible Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations in the low Mach number regime. The method is based on finite differences on staggered grids and is specifically designed to handle the challenges posed by the low Mach number limit, where the system approaches to an incompressible behavior. In this regime, standard explicit schemes suffer from severe time-step restrictions due to fourth-order diffusion terms and the stiffness induced by fast acoustic waves.
